descriptions.notStarted: Mrs. Reade says her problems just never end...
descriptions.inProgress: So we took care of all the rats on The Nautilus but there's still one more problem. And that problem happens to be the main cause of all of Mrs. Reade's problems on The Nautilus- and he still needs to be cleaned! Mrs. Reade's biggest problem is Jack, the one who's to blame for every bit of the mess on The Nautilus! Let me go get some #bPure Water#k so #bJack#k can get a good wash down. \n\n#i2022000##t2022000# #b#c2022000##k / 1
descriptions.completed: Will Jack ever get clean? All this scrubbing doesn't seem to be making him any cleaner... and I'm scrubbing and scrubbing...
